consensus_summary: The consensus primarily identifies the net as a symbol of the gospel, the kingdom of heaven, and evangelistic mission, gathering people of all kinds (as seen in the parables and calling of the disciples). Secondary meanings include a snare or trap used by the wicked or by God in judgment.
book_summary: The book identifies the net as the gospel's gathering of all kinds of people out of the sea of humanity.
consensus_core_identification: The gospel or kingdom of heaven gathering people (evangelism/eschatological sorting).
book_core_identification: The gospel's gathering of all kinds of people.
boundary_disagreement: None. The book's definition directly mirrors the primary consensus view.
rationale: The book's definition is semantically identical to the primary consensus meaning, describing the net as the gospel gathering all kinds of people, supported by the exact same text (Matthew 13:47-48).
strongest_objection: None, as the book and consensus are in complete agreement.
